explanation: Do not cache get_user results for the lifetime of a process: a user whose role is revoked could retain stale permissions. #640 refers to issue 640.
Check db.Query's error before scheduling rows.Close(). On error, rows is nil, so trying to close it would fail.
Use setTimeout with a zero delay for measure(el), rather than queueMicrotask, so measurement happens after the layout has had time to settle.
The token is a Secret<String>. Never log its contents; Debug output must show only a redacted value.
Keep the RetryCount constant in sync with the Http.Retry setting in appsettings.json; change both together. appsettings.json is the configuration file, and Http.Retry is the setting within it.
Before mapping the file, ensure offset is a multiple of pageSize. The memory mapping call rejects an unaligned offset.
Keep the trailing slash on build/: rsync then copies the directory's contents to the destination in DEST, rather than copying the build directory itself.
The BRIN index on events.created_at is chosen for its size: the comment says it is 1% of the size of a btree index. This fits a table whose rows are appended in time order.
Replace this CPU-spinning wait with a futex-based wait. The task is complete when lock_acquire in src/sync/lock.c sleeps while waiting; src/sync/lock.c:lock_acquire identifies the file and function.
Consult the failover section of the runbook for why dbo.RebuildStats runs on the secondary. doc:runbook#failover identifies that document and section; the comment itself does not give the reason.
Keep this request timeout below 60 seconds because the upstream proxy terminates idle requests after 60 seconds. The configured value here is 30 seconds.
Keep Widget's destructor virtual. If it becomes non-virtual, destroying a derived object through a Widget pointer can skip the derived destructor. #915 refers to issue 915.
Enable SQLite foreign key enforcement before any writes on this connection. The PRAGMA applies separately to each connection.
Keep Name as a 40-character ShortString rather than changing it to string, because the record is written directly to disk and a type change would alter its stored bytes.
Bind caller-supplied p_id as a parameter in this dynamic DELETE statement. Concatenating caller input into EXECUTE IMMEDIATE would allow SQL injection.
